title: Architecture Guide: Mock Cosmos and Blob Content
body: Mock DB sources are queried like Cosmos containers, while blob content is exposed through static JSON assets for browser demos.

title: Onboarding Note: Using Blob Content as a Demo Collection
body: Treat each blob JSON file as a document in a Cosmos-style collection to keep the static demo queryable.

title: Release Note: Static Demo Context
body: We now ship static context bundles at build time so the demo can run without server-only API routes.

title: Runbook: Investigate Demo Query Failures
body: Check the context map, verify the generated JSON assets, and inspect the browser query path before falling back to server APIs.
